Narma is an "Enterprise Agentic Brain" designed for AI-first companies to see, prove, and deploy AI automation at scale. The architecture has three layers. Observe (Layer 1): lightweight desktop sensors capture work patterns including application usage, activity sequences, and time allocation. Intelligence Layer (Layer 2): a "Brain" that detects employee intent, the business value of tasks, and "drift" where work diverges from the intended flow. Execution Layer (Layer 3): an "Agent Factory" that automatically generates, deploys, and monitors AI agents for validated high-ROI opportunities with built-in approval gates. The system uses existing foundation models rather than building its own LLMs, focusing instead on the "Work Graph" to reveal where resources are burned and where AI can intercept work mid-flow to provide assistance.

raw.what_makes_this_different: Narma focuses on providing an integrated "Enterprise Agentic Brain" that observes work, identifies AI opportunities, and automates agent deployment, specifically targeting AI-first companies. Unlike solutions that might offer discrete observation or deployment tools, Narma's holistic, three-layered approach with a "Work Graph" vision for "Continuous AI lift" is its unique innovation.

core_insight.why_different: Narma does not build its own LLMs but instead focuses on leveraging existing foundation models and a 'Work Graph' to reveal where resources are burned and where AI can intercept work mid-flow. This contrasts with solutions that may offer only parts like task observation or agent deployment. The integrated three-layer approach is the differentiator.
core_insight.if_wrong: If AI-first companies cannot effectively observe, detect, and measure work patterns, or if the automatic deployment of agents fails to deliver high ROI, then Narma will not be able to provide continuous AI lift and achieve its vision.
